schema.dwd.dim_user: user_id string, user_name string, gender string, age int, city string, province string, member_level string
schema.dwd.dim_product: product_id string, product_name string, category string, sub_category string, brand string, price double
schema.dwd.dim_store: store_id string -- 门店ID, store_name string -- 门店名称, province string -- 省份, city string -- 城市, district string -- 区县, address string -- 详细地址, open_date string -- 开业日期, area int -- 营业面积(㎡), manager string -- 店长
schema.dwd.dwd_order_norm: order_id string, user_id string, store_id string, order_timestamp string, pay_amount double, discount_amount double, raw_status string -- 源系统原始状态, order_status string -- 标准化状态, raw_channel string -- 源系统原始渠道, channel string -- 标准化渠道, order_date string
schema.dwd.dwd_order_item: item_id string -- 明细ID, order_id string -- 订单ID, product_id string -- 商品ID, quantity int -- 数量, unit_price double -- 单价, discount double -- 折扣率, item_amount double -- 明细金额, order_date string -- 订单日期(冗余,便于按天汇总)
schema.dws.dws_sales_day: order_date string -- 订单日期, order_cnt bigint -- 有效订单量, gmv double -- 成交总额, aov double -- 客单价, user_cnt bigint -- 下单用户数, avg_discount double -- 平均优惠金额
schema.dws.dws_sales_week: week_start string -- 周一日期, year_week string -- 年-周, order_cnt bigint, gmv double, user_cnt bigint
schema.dws.dws_sales_month: month string -- yyyy-MM, order_cnt bigint, gmv double, aov double, user_cnt bigint
schema.dws.dws_category_day: order_date string -- 订单日期, category string -- 商品大类, sales double -- 品类销售额, qty bigint -- 销售件数, order_cnt bigint -- 涉及订单数
schema.dws.dws_store_day: order_date string, store_id string, store_name string, province string, city string, sales double, order_cnt bigint, user_cnt bigint
schema.dws.dws_channel_day: order_date string, channel string, sales double, order_cnt bigint, user_cnt bigint
schema.ads.ads_sales_daily: order_date string -- 日期, gmv double -- GMV, order_cnt bigint -- 订单量, aov double -- 客单价, user_cnt bigint -- 下单用户数, dod_rate double -- GMV 日环比(%), gmv_ma7 double -- GMV 7日移动平均
schema.ads.ads_category_top10: rk int -- 排名, category string -- 商品大类, sales double -- 销售额, qty bigint -- 销售件数, order_cnt bigint -- 订单数, sales_share double -- 销售额占比(%), cum_share double -- 累计占比(%)
schema.ads.ads_user_value: user_id string, last_order_date string -- 最近下单日期, recency_days int -- R: 距今天数, frequency bigint -- F: 有效订单数, monetary double -- M: 累计消费, r_score int, f_score int, m_score int, rfm_score int -- RFM 综合分, segment string -- 价值分层
schema.ads.ads_kpi_summary: kpi_name string -- 指标名称, kpi_value double -- 指标值, kpi_unit string -- 单位, calc_desc string -- 计算口径说明, stat_scope string -- 统计范围, calc_time string -- 计算时间
schema.ads.ads_kpi_month: month string, gmv double, order_cnt bigint, aov double, user_cnt bigint, repurchase_rate double -- 当月复购率(%)
